title: The Digital Mirror: Screen Isolation
description: Assess the gap between 'Online Connection' and 'Physical Presence'. Discover if your social life is a hologram.

questions.text: After spending 2 hours on social media, I feel...

options.text: More alone than when I started.
Like a hollow ghost watching a party I'm not invited to.

questions.text: The number of 'Likes' or 'Views' I get changes my mood for the day...

options.text: It's the only thing that makes me feel 'real' or 'seen'.

questions.text: I find it harder to talk to people 'In Person' than through a screen...

options.text: Yes, screen is my safety barrier.
I have almost entirely lost the ability to maintain eye contact or live conversation.

insight_cloud.title: The Paradox of Choice
insight_cloud.text: Digital connection offers 'Breadcrumbs' of sociality without the 'Nutrients' of physical presence (oxytocin, touch, micro-expressions). This leads to 'Hyper-Connectivity' alongside 'Terminal Loneliness'. You aren't 'Connected'; you are 'Tethered'.

questions.text: My phone is the 'First Thing' I reach for when I feel a moment of boredom or silence...

options.text: It's a biological extension of my arm; I can't be 'alone' without it.

questions.text: Do you feel like you are 'performing' your life for an audience that doesn't actually care?

options.text: Yes, I am a content-creator, not a human.
Yes, I am a flickering image with no soul.
